slides.text: Genta designs the Royal Oak for Audemars Piguet.
Patek Philippe introduces the Nautilus, designed by Genta.
The 1970 Royal Oak is called the original groundbreaker.
Audemars Piguet made the Royal Oak. Patek Philippe made the Nautilus.
The Royal Oak came in 1970; the Nautilus followed in 1976.
Same designer. Two brands. Six years apart.
